Bill.BriefDescription: Setting the time limitation for vacating a judgment.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the time limitation for vacating a judgment; andadding a new section to chapter 4.72 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.72 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A judgment or order found to have been secured through perjury orfraud must be vacated or modified. A motion to vacate or modify ajudgment may be brought within one year of a party securing ordiscovering evidence of fraud or perjury.
